title: Travel and expenses trial
details: Add a local base address and preferred map app
Store learner site addresses and calculate one-way road mileage when requested
Calculate mileage for booked review and observation visits and export a mileage CSV
Suggest an efficient same-day learner route and open it in Google Maps or Waze
Store petrol, hotel, parking and other receipt files locally without requiring manual labels
Assessment, review, observation, QR, media and evidence workflows are unchanged
